text: The purpose of this report is to appoint directors to the Uptown Yonge Board of Management for the new term of Council and make necessary changes to Schedule A of the Municipal Code, Chapter 19. Uptown Yonge BIA falls within two Community Council boundaries.

City Council on July 16, 17 and 18, 2019 adopted the following: 1. City Council, in accordance with the City's Public Appointments Policy, appoint the following nominees to the Business Improvement Area Board of Management set out below, at pleasure of Council, and for a term expiring at the end of the term of Council or as soon afterward as successors are appointed: Uptown Yonge: Derrick Adams Gordon Beattie Amar Bhalla Adriana Cutruzzola Amin Datoo Nadine Devereux Scott Hunermund David O. Jubb Karen Kiratzis Alex Mazelow Angelo Moretti Alex Nanoff Kim Prosser Ramzey Trabelsi Jaime Vargas 2. City Council direct that Schedule A of the Municipal Code Chapter 19, Business Improvement Areas, be amended by changing the number of directors of the Board of Management of Uptown Yonge to 18.
